title: Separate Atlas activity DOM from session orchestration
purpose: After accepted R15, establish the smallest real ownership seam needed before any constructed-response integration: move existing Atlas qcm/fill learner markup rendering and raw DOM response reading out of session orchestration into the existing UI-owned render module, while preserving the existing Learn-it core evaluation authority and all learner-visible qcm/fill semantics.
invariants: apps/learnit-next/src/core/session.js remains byte-unchanged and remains the canonical Learn-it qcm/fill normalization and evaluation authority.
Existing Atlas qcm/fill prompts, learner controls, required-answer behavior, feedback flow and response grammars remain behaviorally equivalent.
apps/learnit-next/src/integration/atlas/session.js owns orchestration and lifecycle but no longer owns qcm/fill activity markup or raw DOM response reading.
apps/learnit-next/src/ui/render.js owns the moved learner-safe activity markup and DOM response reading only; it receives no correct-answer key, acceptedValues, evaluator or scoring algorithm.
Planner, evidence, recommendation, memory, transfer, storage, import and claim-authority semantics remain unchanged.
learnit.kit.v2 and authoring payloads remain unchanged.
No constructed-response product support is introduced by this work package.
No generic Activity Runtime, event bus, new persistent schema or new execution class is introduced.
